off_diagonal_pairing.d_wave_pair_center_definition: Delta_d(i)=0.5*(Delta_i,+x + Delta_i,-x - Delta_i,+y - Delta_i,-y), with singlet bond Delta_ij=c_i_up c_j_down - c_i_down c_j_up
off_diagonal_pairing.measurement_note: These are four-fermion off-diagonal correlators. They require additional basis rotations or dedicated fermionic tomography circuits; they cannot be recovered from the existing charge/spin Z-basis pipeline alone.
